section.name: Object IDs and addresses for follow-up root paths

query.name: Bidi objects retaining at least 1 MiB
query.command: oql "SELECT o.@objectId AS id, toHex(o.@objectAddress) AS address, classof(o).@name AS ownerClass, o.@usedHeapSize AS shallowBytes, o.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes FROM \"^org[.]opentaint[.]dataflow[.](bidi|jvm[.]bidi)[.].*\" o WHERE (o.@retainedHeapSize >= 1048576)"

query.name: Soft references retaining at least 1 MiB
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS id, toHex(s.@objectAddress) AS address, s.referent AS referent, s.@usedHeapSize AS shallowBytes, s.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes FROM java.lang.ref.SoftReference s WHERE (s.@retainedHeapSize >= 1048576)"

query.name: AP canonical-key table objects
query.command: oql "SELECT m.@objectId AS id, toHex(m.@objectAddress) AS address, m.markSets AS markSets, m.exclusions AS exclusions, m.paths AS paths, m.initials AS initials, m.premiseSets AS premiseSets FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ApManager m"

query.name: AP hard taint-payload and leaf-node tables
query.command: oql "SELECT m.@objectId AS id, toHex(m.@objectAddress) AS address, m.taintAlg AS taintAlgebra, m.taintAlg.table AS payloadTable, m.taintAlg.leafNodes AS leafNodes FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ApManager m"

query.name: Current run queue and actor-map objects
query.command: oql "SELECT r.@objectId AS id, toHex(r.@objectAddress) AS address, r.actors AS actors, r.queue AS queue, r.channel AS channel, r.queued AS queuedActors FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.UnitRunner r"

query.name: Form-cache interleaved forward and reverse slots
query.command: oql "SELECT f.@objectId AS id, toHex(f.@objectAddress) AS address, f.size AS statements, f.slots AS slots FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.FormsCache f"

query.name: Bidi class instance counts
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@name AS className, c.@numberOfObjects AS instances, c.@heapSizePerInstance AS bytesPerInstance FROM OBJECTS \"^org[.]opentaint[.]dataflow[.](bidi|jvm[.]bidi)[.].*\" c"

query.name: Run manager index and owned state
query.command: oql "SELECT r.@objectId AS id, toHex(r.@objectAddress) AS address, r.config.index AS runIndex, r.config.fieldLimit AS fieldLimit, r.admitting AS admitting, r.status AS status, r.runners AS runners, r.storages AS storages, r.inFlight AS inFlight FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunManager r"

query.name: Method actor direction, counters, and lifecycle fields
query.command: oql "SELECT a.@objectId AS id, toHex(a.@objectAddress) AS address, a.key AS methodKey, a.forward AS forward, a.limit AS fieldLimit, a.mode AS mode, a.steps AS steps, a.demandLayerEdges AS demandLayerEdges, a.recordCrossings AS recordCrossings, a.port AS port, a.runContext AS runContext, a.edgeStore AS edgeStore, a.initialStore AS initialStore, a.local AS localServices, a.calls AS callServices, a.publicationSink AS publicationSink, a.linkStore AS links, a.summaries AS summaries, a.sourceHits AS sourceHits FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a"

query.name: Method edge-store dense premise arrays
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS id, toHex(s.@objectAddress) AS address, s.method AS methodKey, s.size AS statements, s.fieldLimit AS fieldLimit, s.groups AS premiseArrays, s.reach AS reach, s.interners AS trieInterners FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.MethodEdgeStore s"

query.name: Actors with runner port retained
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.port != null)

query.name: Actors with method edge store retained
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.edgeStore != null)

query.name: Actors with local services retained
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.local != null)

query.name: Actors with run context retained
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.runContext != null)

query.name: Forward actors with active runner port
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.forward = true AND a.port != null)

query.name: Backward actors with active runner port
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.forward = false AND a.port != null)

query.name: Actors with all four work-owner fields released
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS a FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.RunMethodAnalyzer a WHERE (a.port = null AND a.edgeStore = null AND a.local = null AND a.runContext = null)
